description: Clones the bot from GitHub, installs dependencies, generates the Prisma client, and boots the ShardingManager. Optionally applies database migrations and registers slash commands on start. Requires an external PostgreSQL database.
startup: if [[ "${AUTO_UPDATE}" == "1" ]]; then echo "[*] Updating from origin/${GIT_BRANCH} ..."; git fetch origin "${GIT_BRANCH}" && git reset --hard "origin/${GIT_BRANCH}" && npm ci; fi; if [[ "${RUN_MIGRATIONS}" == "1" ]]; then echo "[*] Applying migrations ..."; npx prisma migrate deploy || exit 1; fi; if [[ "${REGISTER_COMMANDS}" == "1" ]]; then echo "[*] Registering slash commands ..."; node src/scripts/register-commands.js || exit 1; fi; node src/index.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Joint Jagadeesan — installation
# Install container is Debian bookworm, matching the parkervcp/yolks Node runtime,
# so the Prisma engine binaries generated here are the right ones at boot.
set -euo pipefail

apt-get update
# build-essential + python3 let node-gyp compile the `re2` native addon (automod's
# regex engine). re2's install downloads a prebuilt when available and falls back to
# a source build; without a toolchain that fallback fails and re2.node is missing at boot.
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates openssl build-essential python3

if [ -z "${GIT_REPO:-}" ]; then
  echo "[!] GIT_REPO is empty."
  exit 1
fi
BRANCH="${GIT_BRANCH:-main}"

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -d /mnt/server/.git ]; then
  echo "[*] Updating existing checkout to origin/${BRANCH} ..."
  git remote set-url origin "${GIT_REPO}"
  git fetch origin "${BRANCH}"
  git reset --hard "origin/${BRANCH}"
else
  echo "[*] Cloning ${GIT_REPO} (branch ${BRANCH}) ..."
  git clone --depth 1 --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH}" "${GIT_REPO}" /tmp/repo
  cp -R /tmp/repo/. /mnt/server/
  rm -rf /tmp/repo
fi

echo "[*] Installing dependencies ..."
# A full install is required: the `prisma` CLI is a devDependency, and it is needed
# both by the postinstall hook (prisma generate) and by `prisma migrate deploy` at
# boot. Do NOT change this to --omit=dev unless prisma moves to dependencies.
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci
else
  npm install
fi

# re2's install prefers a downloaded prebuilt and only source-builds on the ||
# fallback; if that download 'succeeds' as a no-op the binary can be missing. Force a
# source build when it's absent so re2.node always exists (needs the toolchain above).
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/node_modules/re2/build/Release/re2.node ]; then
  echo "[*] Building re2 native addon from source ..."
  ( cd /mnt/server/node_modules/re2 && npm run rebuild )
fi

# Fail loudly rather than letting the panel mark a broken server as "installed".
echo "[*] Verifying install ..."
test -d /mnt/server/node_modules || { echo "[!] node_modules missing"; exit 1; }
test -d /mnt/server/node_modules/.prisma/client || { echo "[!] Prisma client was not generated"; exit 1; }
test -f /mnt/server/node_modules/re2/build/Release/re2.node || { echo "[!] re2 native binary missing (build failed)"; exit 1; }
test -f /mnt/server/src/index.js || { echo "[!] src/index.js missing"; exit 1; }

echo "[*] Install complete."

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: HTTPS URL of the bot's repository (must be public).

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal. Keep secret.

variables.name: Discord Client ID
variables.description: Application ID from the Discord Developer Portal.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: PostgreSQL connection string, e.g. postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/dbname?sslmode=disable. Percent-encode any special characters in the password.

variables.name: Run Migrations On Boot
variables.description: 1 = run `prisma migrate deploy` before starting. Boot aborts if migrations fail.

variables.name: Register Slash Commands On Boot
variables.description: 1 = run src/scripts/register-commands.js before starting. Set to 1 after changing commands, then back to 0 — re-registering on every boot wastes Discord API quota.

variables.name: Auto Update On Boot
variables.description: 1 = git reset to the latest branch commit and reinstall dependencies on every start. Slows boot considerably; leave at 0 and use Reinstall instead.

variables.name: Shard Count
variables.description: "auto" or a positive integer. Deliberately not named SHARD_COUNT — discord.js reads that name internally and it would break a standalone client.

variables.name: Dev Guild ID
variables.description: Optional. Guild ID for instant guild-scoped command registration during development.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: fatal, error, warn, info, debug, or trace.
